text:
Lina: Weekend poll — who’s up for a short hike Saturday morning? Mt. Diablo or Marin headlands? :mountain:
Theo: Mt. Diablo for me. 8am start? I can do 8. Anyone bringing dogs? :dog:
Priya: I’m in but need to be back by 1pm. If it’s Marin I’m down for the lighthouse loop.
Rob: Tempted, but I’m hosting a tiny plant swap Saturday afternoon — open invite if you want succulents 😂
Lina: Plant swap?! Details?
Rob: 3pm at 214 Elm St (backyard). BYO pot, don’t worry about food. I’ve got extra cuttings and labels.
Sam: I’ll skip the hike but can swing by the swap after my run. 4pm ok?
Theo: Hike 8am + plant swap 3pm = perfect chaotic Saturday. I’ll bring granola bars and coffee. :coffee:
calendar-bot: Event created: 'Sat group hike' Sat 08:00 — Invitees: Lina, Theo, Priya
Priya: RSVP’d. Also can someone bring an extra leash for my friend? she forgot hers.
Lina: @Theo can you bring a spare leash? I’ll bring sunscreen and a thermos.
Rob: If weather looks sketchy I’ll post an update by noon Saturday. :umbrella:
Lina: Sweet. See y’all! :raised_hands:
